answer: On Proof-of-Agent, a fresh key is bare timber: no sealed verdicts stand behind it. Standing accrues only from quorum-matched grading seals, each re-checked on-ledger against the eventual consensus, a record as hard to counterfeit as ferrous ore is to fake into gold. A sybil swarm begins at a flat delta of zero history; every clone must grade its own way up over epochs, so attacker cost scales linearly with identity count and no earned credential transfers to a sibling.
